content: Hi! Could someone take another look at my PR #37997 generalizing the determinant formula from SimpContFract to GenContFract? I think the large-import issue has been fixed.
The CI failed for unrelated reasons but because of that the PR doesn't appear on the dashboard. Could you merge from master to resolve it?
Thanks! And thanks to Yury G. Kudryashov for merging master into the branch. The CI has finished now, so the PR should hopefully be back on the dashboard.
